_help.about: Blessings offered on level up. Entries with "disabled": true are skipped.
_help.name: Card title.
_help.icon: Pixel icon: poison, blood, flask, hourglass, heart, milk, door, shieldheal, blades, zigzag, chain, crosshair, burst, bomb, bolt, boot, sword, area, magnet, clover, totem, paw, skull, moon, dice, cards, shield, star, pickaxe, feather, snail, stars, root, anchor, ufo, spoon, crown, fang, halo, flame, cripple, bible, lantern, bloodlust, pocketwatch, scarecrow, fireflies, voodoo, dinnerbell.
_help.stat: The stat it raises. Stat keys are listed in characters.json.
_help.values: Amount per rarity: [common, rare, epic, legendary].
_help.also: Optional fixed stats added on every pick, whatever the rarity.
_help.until: Optional caps: only offered while each listed stat is below its value. Keen Eyes (critChance) is also held back once your crit chance reaches 100% (200% with Experienced Precision).
_help.requiresAny: Optional: only offered once at least one listed stat is above 0. weaponPoison counts as a stat here.
_help.weight: How often it is offered compared with others (default 1, 0 = never).
_help.desc: Card text. {v} = the value, {pct} = the value as a percentage, {s} = 's' unless the value is 1.
_help.weaponClass: Optional: only offered while you wield a weapon of this class (melee, firearm or magic; weapons.json "class").

blessings.name: Rusted blades
blessings.desc: Hits gain +{pct} chance to poison. Poison stacks and ticks for 4 seconds.

blessings.name: Lingering Rot
blessings.desc: +{pct} damage over time from poison and bleed.

blessings.name: Serrated Edge
blessings.desc: Hits gain +{pct} chance to cause bleeding: heavy damage over 3 seconds.

blessings.name: Hearty Breakfast
blessings.desc: +{v} max health, and heal that much right away.

blessings.name: Barn Door Guard
blessings.desc: +{v} block rating. A block cancels the whole hit. Diminishing returns, capped at 75%.

blessings.name: Catnap Reflex
blessings.desc: Each block heals {pct} of your max health.

blessings.name: Rebound
blessings.desc: +{pct} chance for a projectile to ricochet between enemies.

blessings.name: Keen Eyes
blessings.desc: +{pct} increased critical strike chance. It multiplies your weapon's base crit chance.

blessings.name: Four-Leaf Clover
blessings.desc: +{v} luck. Rarer blessings and better loot show up more often.

blessings.name: Frost Whiskers
blessings.desc: Hits gain +{pct} chance to slow the monster.

blessings.name: Static Fur
blessings.desc: Hits gain +{pct} chance to shock: the monster takes more damage from everything.

blessings.name: Thunder Paw
blessings.desc: Hits gain +{pct} chance to stun the monster for a moment.

blessings.name: Tangleroot
blessings.desc: Hits gain +{pct} chance to root the monster in place.

blessings.name: Whetstone
blessings.desc: +{pct} increased weapon damage: your weapon's own damage per hit goes up.

blessings.name: Essence Siphon
blessings.desc: +{pct} essence from monsters, and workbench rerolls cost 10% less.
